_comment: The Expanse — MCRN / MarsBlue. RE-GROUNDED 2026-05-27 from actual show footage (cockpit tactical screens, 'This is the Warship MarsBlue'): deep NAVY base + MUTED blue-white UI (NOT electric cyan), restrained with lots of negative space; red kept rare/small (threat markers). System-color triad still applies (red=danger/green=go/yellow=warn). layout=cockpit, chrome=instrument. See refs/mars-blue/NOTES.md + bmg_raw_visual_for_design memory (palette study should use raw frames, not montages).

data._comment: Navy→blue-white ladder, muted to match the restrained cockpit screens. System colors amber[4]/red[5] fire only on 5+ categories so red stays a rare signal (accent-discipline).

type._comment: Show uses modified DIN Pro; D-DIN not on a clean CDN so Saira (OFL, DIN-adjacent) is the bundled stand-in (notebook.css @font-face). mono = Space Mono for the command-line/telemetry texture.
